name: translogic-gestion-flotas
description: TRANSLOGIC S.A. — Sistema inteligente de gestión de flotas, servicios y facturación (monorepo)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
